STRONGEST_SOURCE_FINDING=current Fold7ContinuityController treats nativeCover=(coverActive && coverIsDefault && !innerActive) plus <=12deg as sufficient to enter NATIVE_COVER, while Fold7Gen2Kernel invalidates close-cycle frame/readiness and coordinator immediately HideMirror/ReleaseSecondary -> DisplayMirrorHost.detach/remove. That proves a terminal ordering gap: logical/power native ownership is used as permission to tear down the last Duo visual without destination/native-frame presentation acknowledgement. DEVICE FAILURE INCIDENCE IS NOT CLAIMED. PROPOSED GEN3 CONTRACT=insert SamsungNativeHandoffOwner after exact CoverVisualLease/PresentationOwner: native topology is admission only; keep the exact Duo terminal visual and cycle alive in NATIVE_PENDING; cross one or more API35 TransactionCompleted PRESENTED barriers on the exact service-stable host/visual binding; then submit fade-to-native and allow CLEAN release only after the exact fade transaction is presented. Reversal/topology loss/new cycle/host remap/service epoch/visual attempt invalidates old terminal tokens. Watchdog escape is explicitly DEGRADED_TIMEOUT. IMPORTANT_LIMITATION=our overlay transaction completion proves our transaction was presented, not that Samsung Launcher/SystemUI produced a fresh matching buffer underneath; this is a compositor landing window, not native-content provenance proof. VALIDATION=Pure Kotlin model PASS=11/11 plus deterministic 100000-event stream. Initial random run failure is preserved: harness incorrectly asserted nativeTopologyStable forever after a valid historical clean release; correction moved the assertion to clean-release emission without weakening owner conditions. RECONCILIATION=reviewer presentation-owner final handoff requires service-stable hostLeaseId/global visualAttemptId and treats TransactionCompleted as PRESENTED_CALLBACK; this work consumes that contract and no longer assumes current host-local hostEpoch/attemptSequence. Reviewer launcher-content-freshness is complementary and owns semantic content freshness. performance-rd has separately claimed terminal handoff timing/evidence budget and explicitly excludes this architecture, so barrier count/fade/watchdog tuning should consume that work rather than hardcode model values. Primary Alpha1 remains on the same production SHA and had not yet closed this terminal handoff stage. No production GitHub writes, APK publication, or installation authorization occurred.
